notes.title: Throw | Visual Effects | Skills and Attacks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/1a1052ed803b5d82bb72823cdc411f5357a83b34.png[/img]

This time we want to show you the “Throw” attack type.

In this series of videos we are going to show you the visual effects that the different types of attacks and abilities will have in the game.

Keep in mind that in these videos the effects are shown with an enlarged card and without the magnificent context that battlefields give it.

[previewyoutube=51DeCHxWJfo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Helga | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/770d6235736911ed71d0cfd4432e920eb318f352.jpg[/img]

Helga is a creature of common rarity of the Fire element. She has 1 and 5 attack and defense points respectively for only 3 crystals, which makes her a very useful card for the Early Game.

In addition, it is an upgradeable card so it will gradually improve.

[previewyoutube=tB67N8f1_9I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Spell | Visual Effects | Skills and Attacks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/bc4f52341f97a14df5c5122f895f01c78c4ed4cb.png[/img]

In this series of videos we are going to show you the visual effects that the different types of attacks and abilities will have in the game.

We start with the “Spell” attack type.

Keep in mind that in these videos the effects are shown with an enlarged card and without the magnificent context that battlefields give it.

[previewyoutube=MKi13dTKmsQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Sectarian | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/50d336e0470cb050d2b98f42df1b652e392e6995.jpg[/img]

The Sectarian is a common card of the Darkness element, which for its rarity is very powerful. It has 3 and 4 attack and defense points respectively for a cost of 4 crystals. But there is a price to pay for this card... Its "Thirst 1" ability causes it to inflict 1 point of damage to a card that is on an adjacent square randomly before attacking. If there are no cards that can take the damage, it will remain inactive.

[previewyoutube=z66FOyUAbWw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Umpy | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/6d139167ada04f0b5b62cb801f6d4d3e315b0446.jpg[/img]

Umpy is a common creature of the Water element that is a good option for the early game since it is a creature with 1 and 4 points of attack and health respectively with a cost of only 2 crystals.

[previewyoutube=Ut_Y04c5JuE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Sylvanian Armor | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/eb02caf9ef60af01b60fdd41efcf6e69b8eb1700.jpg[/img]

The Sylvanian Armor is one of the most powerful equipment cards in the game that belongs to the Earth element.

In addition to increasing the equipped card's health by 4, it grants it the "Guardian" ability, which halves the damage dealt to your Leadership.

[previewyoutube=iZeqCLVG-zo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ghuhae | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/dcb7b5bed85d5f9c9f1395ce71928dc7d55adcc1.jpg[/img]

Ghuhae is a hero that allows us to form squads of 6 creatures with equipment. This comes in very useful to incorporate, for example, the cursed axe.

It's an ancestral spirit coming from the sacred Udhin volcanoes.

[previewyoutube=6FuAsElSvag;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hidden Leader | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/7fab2ed9d3c2477fce791c329d1e392955725f32.jpg[/img]

This hero allows us to form 7 creature squads to have units that can destroy the enemy. Despite the cost of 6 crystals, it has 3 attack points and 7 defence points, which makes it very dangerous.

It's part of the light infantry of the Tervid troops, that usually use light armoury to have more mobility. It's not common that one of the army leaders doesn't want to show their face to avoid being recognised, but this hero prefers to remain anonymous.

[previewyoutube=wPm6Z8DRcko;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Cursed Blade | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/abc294d75e0f0cfdecf0dce4e5ba6d556c08f053.jpg[/img]

The Cursed Blade is a card of the Darkness element that can be beneficial as well as harmful since having the "Curse 2" ability reduces the attack of damaged cards by 2 (both yours and the enemy's) while on the battlefield.

For this reason, we recommend that you combine this card with others that make your cards heal and count most of the time with all the life points.

[previewyoutube=m8_x24cWyPs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Yaereene | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/9390cca081fa227af2637006c6641e4c4de48d7f.jpg[/img]

Yaereene is one of the common Earth Element creatures with the Shot attack type.

[previewyoutube=kXymN7e7ZJs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gryphon Knight | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/9b353d15846ef5c1740148a4b9a11b99af5b856e.jpg[/img]

The Gryphon Knight is an upgradable creature of the Light element that can become quite a threat to the opponent when it arrives on the battlefield.

[previewyoutube=TFQqTq2_jV0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Okuhr | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/46fba3a57e0720180e81d315940bee598a81a687.jpg[/img]

Okuhr is one of those creatures that can wreak havoc on the enemy. Even though he only has 1 attack point, he has 7 defense points.

But this is not the most important thing… The key is that it has the "Sneak Attack" ability that makes it move to a random empty square before attacking, if possible.

[previewyoutube=TveAZzGuzYQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Judge Ethred | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/ff0dc6fb3c41ae6a2c6dc30da562b8f57b545338.jpg[/img]

Judge Ethred is one of the most powerful creatures of the Mercenaries since for only 3 crystals we have a creature with 1 and 6 attack and defense points respectively.

In addition, it has the abilities "Blood Ties", which means that enemy cards can't attack allied cards of the same element with Basic Strike, and "Strengthen 1", thanks to which it increases the attack of permanently one of the random allied cards on the battlefield at the end of each turn.

[previewyoutube=P_c-z6aid6E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hydris | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/959d77315edd710ddba73e317061a314c5ef38ee.jpg[/img]

Hydris is one of those creatures that you would never want to meet if you are sailing the ocean.

It is an upgradable Water card that continues to wreak havoc even after death thanks to its "Agony Strike 3" ability. It must also be said that it is a difficult card to kill since with its "Necrophagia" ability it recovers its full health when it destroys an enemy card.

[previewyoutube=LsVhhxz6SPw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Özgür, the Merciless Hunter | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/200972fbbc8e322766c939ee097b6068a95ca965.jpg[/img]

Özgür, the Merciless Hunter, is one of the most powerful cards in the Earth Element Main Set. In addition of being a hero that allows us to create squads of 5 creatures, 1 equipment, and 1 terrain, it has 4 and 6 attack and defense points respectively.

Besides thanks to his "Precision" ability, he always attacks the enemy hero or creature card with the most attack points, regardless of the position it is in. And as if that wasn't enough, with the "Guardian" ability, halve the damage dealt to your leadership.

[previewyoutube=2CrZL2tNrX0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dwarf Mentor | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/e737c47eddc3e3313043c88aacbe56763df427c4.jpg[/img]

The Dwarf Mentor is a card of the Fire element with a cost of 3 crystals and 3 and 4 points of attack and defense respectively.

It is an ideal card in order to play versus squads that have equipment, as with its ""Disarm"" ability it is able to destroy a random enemy equipment card at the end of each turn.

[previewyoutube=uw3ugKuTzW4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Art Creation Process | Speedpaint
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/b3a912286bc0a45e51d7c61cf7d3415508df26ad.png[/img]

This time, we want to show you how the process of creating an art takes place, carried out by one of the artists who create illustrations for our cards.

This time it is an art that will be used on an Earth element card in a future expansion, but we also want to show what's to come. We will also be adding more videos of the arts that we are presenting to you little by little.

The program used is Adobe Photoshop, so it can also serve as a tutorial to learn some tricks.

It is a very interesting video and it is worth it to know all the ins and outs behind each illustration, which are not few.

We hope you like it!

[previewyoutube=tp3WJNZn1ag;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Black Dragon | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/ae90ab47441714610ba34a3d5c413a8259945485.jpg[/img]

We are going with one of the flagships of the main set of the Light element.

It is the Black Dragon, an indomitable beast capable of devastating the battlefield with its breath of fire.

It has 1 attack point that is countered by its 7 health points and its cost of 3 crystals.

In addition, it has the abilities "Flight" and "Fire Breath 2", which make it unaffected by attacks from creatures without "Flying" and inflict 2 points of damage each turn to the card in front of it before attacking and change the attack type of all damaged enemy cards that have Shot for Basic Strike.

[previewyoutube=PdPJhl1pHf8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Art Sketch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/6f0fe5eb465032721189e5f05b50eeab76a5faa5.png[/img]

All Berserk card arts are being developed by different artists that we will reveal when the time comes.

In this post we want to show you how the sketches of each art are proposed and the progress of the illustration in 3 steps.

Later we will share a complete video in which you will be able to enjoy the complete process that an illustration goes through before being implemented in a card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/f72ba8eb1fc0bfb03afcde5be5d91b2267ff3b0f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Or'gurid | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/2ed520b803b43e1b6ba3a538ddcb6a5680806e67.jpg[/img]

Or'gurid is one of the most powerful heroes of the Dark element. For only 4 crystals, we will have a beast with 2 attack points and 7 defense.

In addition, he is a special hero since he allows us to create a squad of 5 creatures, 1 equipment and 1 terrain.

And as if that weren't enough, he has the ability "Plague" with which he inflicts the same amount of damage that Or'gurid suffers on receiving an attack to the opposing card.

[previewyoutube=pkGhD3_zwV0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 2 Squads Battle | Berserk Reborn
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/215f2e2969e0a9a1736558311557ff288b3b5056.png[/img]

We are proud to finally show you an exciting match from Berserk Reborn.

In this case we play manually, since you will also have an automatic game mode available, against the AI in a 2 squads battle. In our case we have selected Earth and Darkness and we have incorporated Mercenary cards.

In the video you can see how a fight takes place (in this case with an accelerated pace) and the different visual effects that have been added to the skills.

Different movements such as card draw, positioning on the battlefield and other details are also appreciated.

Keep in mind that this is an early Beta match and we will be making a lot of improvements until finally you can participate in the Closed Beta that we will be running very soon. See you in Udhin!

[previewyoutube=McpliV6hHNE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Prishan | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/3bdae2758d3e9f1adfaf989cb2ea19652fa8bf81.jpg[/img]

Prishan is an ancient Paladin who abandoned his union to join the Renegade Brotherhood, formed up of all the renegades and rejected characters of the different elements. We can find creatures of every type among their ranks, from elves to dwarves, wizards and sorcerers from every lar.

[previewyoutube=9CCs-3urFAE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Sarcosuchus Imperator | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/c15c11f96e6fdf84877567803dbfae1f09ec30b8.jpg[/img]

The Sarcosuchus Imperator is one of those creatures that you would not like to come across because you will most likely end up devoured.

It is a common creature of the Water element that costs 4 crystals and has 2 attack and 4 defense points.

[previewyoutube=blM08E1eKXU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gekhael, the Rock Golem | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/bdc05efe3ec54318db3932427287cb2111fdc6cb.jpg[/img]

Gekhael is an ancient golem who tries to protect the forest from everything. He is a hero with no abilities but he is very resistant and long-lasting during battles.

We can form squads of 7 creatures with this hero.

[previewyoutube=Yo-Q9pVROrE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Centaur Leader | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/96e5eb74c6f3048689d0f4c991330fec4f18c8e5.jpg[/img]

The Centaur Leader is a Fire element hero which can be used to include an equipment in our squads.

In addition, for only 3 crystals we have a creature with 2 attack points and 5 life points.

[previewyoutube=MLla48NIZno;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Angel | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/143ce2b7f351d18fc62d0078cdc9a9cb08f3b66c.jpg[/img]

The Angel is a Light Element creature that has Immunity to Spells.

It is a quick action card, since for only 3 crystals we have a unit with 2 attack points.

[previewyoutube=OOWyErTEO_s;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Cursed Nun | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/9c713d4e7676e9ed226670492fcf014171820259.jpg[/img]

In the illustration of the Cursed Nun we can see how she tears off the wings of a fallen angel to prevent him from flying anymore.

This makes sense due to its abilities, which make it a very powerful and useful card to fight with creatures that have the "Flight" ability, since the "Hunter" ability causes it to permanently remove the "Flight" ability permanently from one random enemy card at the end of every turn. It also has "Vampirism", with which it recovers a number of health points equal to the damage inflicted on the enemy card or the enemy Leadership.

[previewyoutube=WmnOKxY_hHI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Collection and Card Details
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/4caaba886ff36adc7addb9a37a60aa7f169d6a08.jpg[/img]

In this new video we show you how your card collection and card details will look like.

In the collection section you will be able to see in a general way all the cards you have and the quantity of each of them that you have at your disposal. You can filter by type of card and by element so that you can check which are the best cards you have and the ones you will need for each fight.

As for the card details, when you click on any of your cards, you will be able to see all its characteristics: type, element, rarity, set to which it belongs, attack type and abilities.

Stay tuned because we will continue to show you more aspects and features of the game so that you can get to know in detail Berserk Reborn and Udhin.

[previewyoutube=GDndYk0ARFU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Fire Controller | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/69199e078035093c90ad47b30702216b5fb35e1b.jpg[/img]

The Fire Controller's art has been one of the few that has been carried over from Alpha to Beta, but we want to show you how it looks like with the new card frame.

[previewyoutube=a662XFYzfgQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Kerhan | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/7fb1530052093396fa90807b4e985bc0ccd92a4e.jpg[/img]

Kerhan is a hero belonging to the Water Element that is used to create squads of 7 creatures.

For a cost of only 3 crystals you can put on your side a hero with 2 attack and 6 defense points.

[previewyoutube=3w5zNzIDdts;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Centaur Scout | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/019712b8aa80b9c22c3ec3fac60007daba14649a.jpg[/img]

The Centaur Scout is an Earth card that has the abilities "Immunity to Throws" and "Call 1". Thanks to this last ability, when it comes into play takes 1 crystal away from a random card on your hand, which makes it very interesting for quick-play squads.

[previewyoutube=HpZ7RpyGsCM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Blazing Rock Amazon | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/9ee628034c71934bccab1e48f379b99f8e534028.jpg[/img]

The Blazing Rock Amazon is part of the Ingemar tribe, composed by very agile and fast warriors. They are very curious and creative by nature, so you will always find them exploring the vast mountains of Udhin. They usually wear comfortable and wide clothing, made of wool and different types of skin.

Thanks to his abilities "Direct Hit 1" and "Rage" she becomes a powerful creature that, despite having a cost of 6 crystals, is a great threat to the enemy and his units.

[previewyoutube=t4EP3HWL6Ps;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Axe Thrower | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/39b6b4a31b010a99b7540cf99f08a1596c733b29.jpg[/img]

The Axe Thrower is a Light creature that has no abilities, but it does have the "Throw" attack type, which is very useful in order to fight creatures with the "Basic Strike" attack type.

There are very few cards with this attack type at the moment, which makes them a good addition to any squad.

[previewyoutube=ytacxaSspbM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Bloody Zombie | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/8fec50d771c102e22d3876b32c72b0ad1a8edff8.jpg[/img]

The Bloody Zombie is a card that, despite not having any abilities, can be very effective at the beginning of the battle since with a cost of only 2 crystals you have a unit with 1 attack point and 5 defense points.

In addition, it can be upgraded... Maybe in some of its phases it achieves some ability.

[previewyoutube=FlkJaPD8o2I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Squad Formation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/75c61e533c150e02c972778a559345a779cd0b96.jpg[/img]

Finally, we're going to drop tidbits of the game itself so you can enjoy and delight in the core of the game. 

In this case, we’ll show you how the squads of 8 cards that you’ll need to fight in Berserk Reborn are formed. 

Once you’ve formed at least 3 squads, you’ll be ready for battle. Right now, the battles against the AI will be random, so they can be 1, 2 or 3 squads. 

We hope you like it!

[previewyoutube=rMF1IvvSbwE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Khor-Vain | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/b96257143b2bf731fd8b2e125c7fbd58f3662ed8.jpg[/img]

Khor-Vain is one of the most powerful earth cards from the principal set for two reasons: 

1. It’s a Mercenaries card, so you can include it in any of your squads that has a hero capable of equipping terrains. 
2. Its skill, “Power of the Chosen Ones 2” gives all its heroes and mercenaries cards +2 attack while this card remains on the battlefield.

[previewyoutube=XB8DdX4Vcy4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gilnet Falls | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/5e11d34c338e885638f9ed7a92f348e483eb1507.jpg[/img]

The Gilnet Falls are a very useful terrain from the Water element for protecting your units since they have the “Pall 2” skill.

This skill causes all allied cards to receive the “Disguise 2” skill, thanks to which they evade damage from the first 2 attacks they receive.

[previewyoutube=cqJ7nJZJY0I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Evenrayn | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/91ff22d96ee1bab34bcfb06bd7b24f2363c94a0e.jpg[/img]

The Earth element has a terrain card known as Evenrayn, a magical area of the Sacred Forest whose waters flow into the Ocean of Yaint.  

With its “Healing Power 2” skill, it lets all allied cards with the “Healing” or “Last Healing” skill restore 2 additional health points while this card remains on the battlefield.

[previewyoutube=ziEOMdW35VY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Magma Castle | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/f98cf0915fee13c95bf5f9f0519b27695ab4e217.jpg[/img]

For the Fire element, we present the Magma Castle, a very powerful terrain card. 

While this card is on the battlefield, thanks to its “Shoulder to Shoulder 1” skill, it will provide all allied Fire element cards with the “Formation 1” skill, whereby cards with said skill gain +1 attack if any cards on adjacent squares have the “Formation” skill. 

[previewyoutube=5a_5DAnBnYo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Herst Citadel | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/74c63aa77e9cfdd837da50acad5717b3bea41ee9.jpg[/img]

Let’s talk about terrain cards! These cards have their special place on the battlefield, and their main purpose is to power up all of your hero and creature cards. 

Herst Citadel is one of the main strongholds of the Kingdom of Tudgarth, which is the largest, most powerful and civilized kingdom in all of Udhin. Geographically it consists of two states that are united: Tervid and Ethellen. 

This is where the units of the main fighting force of Tudgarth come from, which also accounts for its symbol, the knights. Armored soldiers clad in shining steel armor are the pride of Tervid!

[previewyoutube=1E3g74xjvdI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dark Student | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/1b4de48095d42e6278d4aa8964de0fc9da6cd912.jpg[/img]

Here we have another fairly considerable art change. We can see how the Dark Student extracts the soul from the body of one of his victims. He’s a young wizard apprentice of the Order of Santhniar. Despite his youth, he’s already a hero with whom you can form squads of 7 creatures. 

To go into a little more detail, the Dark Student is training to eventually join the Soul Hunters, a special group. Most of them are mad vivisectors who create grotesque monsters out of living flesh.  

[previewyoutube=1rs_aBJh_j0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Allmighty Blade | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/fc9601d6ccdbff9ae264b9a148504e21acfb2592.jpg[/img]

The Allmighty Blade is the most powerful equipment that you can find in this Beta Phase. It’s also a card that any squad can incorporate since it’s part of the Mercenaries.

It gives the skills “Vampirism” and “Concentration 1” to the equipped creature, restoring its defense points by a quantity equal to the damage dealt to enemy cards, but if that wasn’t enough, it increases its attack points by 1 per turn. Like we said, allmighty.

[previewyoutube=sfNazqCdG8s;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Regeneration Orb | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/b22e8134f75e99924ba7ce1ae98dfe77d8ef4cbd.jpg[/img]

The Regeneration Orb is a Water object ideal for turning one of your units into a beast that’s almost impossible to kill.

This equipment supports the “Regeneration 2” skill, which makes the card that possesses it regenerate 2 defense points per turn.

[previewyoutube=c_vFzHG3nxs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Magic Cloak | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/058634805bc36aeb8f8fd7ba9554ad2a48b669b4.jpg[/img]

The Magic Cloak is a piece of Earth equipment that is very useful for fighting squads dominated by creatures with the “Fly” ability.

Thanks to this equipment, the card that possesses it will increase its defense by one point and receive the “Hideout” ability, which makes attacks from creatures with the “Fly” ability have no effect on it.

[previewyoutube=dIFl2M480sY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Cursed Axe | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/5c3460bcb6c0d5f88abcb34319dea7c614707cdd.jpg[/img]

Although it may seem like the Cursed Axe belongs to Darkness, nothing could be further from the truth. 

It’s a piece of Fire equipment that empowers the equipped creature considerably by providing the skills Attack +1 and Direct Hit +1, increasing its attack points by 1 and causing each turn to deal one point of direct damage to the enemy's Leadership.

[previewyoutube=SByR--IRrso;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Restoring Potion | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/4f52777f4e1bb73125437e5e8b73cf9055f02ec8.jpg[/img]

In this case, we’re focusing on a piece of equipment from the Light element. It’s the Restoring Potion, which increases the health of the equipped creature by 3 points.

It can be quite useful, making a unit become practically indestructible and a huge threat to their rival.

[previewyoutube=5Nea_eiHKWw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Book of Darkness | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/995006b5d64fa69af3b0be7b6c3ef557378ec589.jpg[/img]

We begin by presenting the equipment cards. These types of cards, as their name implies, equip creatures or heroes and provide them with skills which augment their power. 

In this instance, we present the Book of Darkness, a piece of Dark Equipment that provides the skill “Health +1” and “Magic Mirror,” which increases the health of the equipped card by 1 and redirects Spell and Lightning attacks towards an enemy card at random. 

[previewyoutube=PPbj_SZpkAQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Katana Warrior | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/f56f0152207938cd50f800c75a334c1deeb15098.jpg[/img]

Katana Warrior is one of the members of the Brotherhood of Renegades in charge of the assassinations that require the coldest blood. 

He comes from lands unknown to date, but he’s preparing exploration groups to try to locate and put a name to his place of origin. 

[previewyoutube=8hAcD6nUDZw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Azure Wizard | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/43cb30b6c6eb8dd81b6b29aa91a5199315f1dab5.jpg[/img]

The Azure Wizard is part of the Kromm, a group of fanatics who worship the great wizard, who not so long ago provoked chaos in the world and in herself. The Order has a strict hierarchy and is led by the powerful Axkrumm with the support of the other three leaders of the Order. 

Thanks to her “Maneuver” skill, at the end of each turn the card is moved one square to the left (if the square is occupied, the cards change positions), and it can deal damage to different enemy units, sowing chaos on the battlefield.

[previewyoutube=3J1lEukM2qE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Vestrea | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/58e07d40d0297dae3a3fd767ddc52d0563d2a833.jpg[/img]

The transformation of Vestrea’s art compared to his Alpha Phase art is considerable. The card’s theme has changed so that he seems much more warlike and imposing. 

As we’ve already said, Vestrea is part of the House of the Scarlet Rose, which focuses on the study and perfection of magic. They form the bulk of the magical power of the elves. Among the members of this House and the House of the White Oak, relations are a bit tense since each one considers its specialization to be the most important for the protection of the forests.

[previewyoutube=TIZMDlktNHI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Olgah, Angel of Fire | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/b1f24820066526ad5338d989be388809d3df48c9.jpg[/img]

Olgah, Angel of Fire is one of the most powerful fire element creatures, and he is part of the group known as the Elemental Angels. 

With his “Hidden Attack” and “Rage” skills he becomes a huge threat, since in each of his attacks he deals double damage to your leadership if there is an empty square on the battlefield.

[previewyoutube=UM5ioSoIcH0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Arctic Warrior | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/28cea241a35a5449c3f4253700ae297a19d0f278.jpg[/img]

With the Alpha phase reveals, we now present you the Arctic Warrior. We hope you enjoy! 

We're talking about one of the leaders of the troops of Tervid. He comes from the northern part of the continent, and for this reason part of his body is ice, which terrifies his enemies when they see him on the battlefield. 

With his Whirlwind of Blades 1 skill, he deals 1 Basic Strike damage to three enemy cards every turn, which makes him a huge threat to his rivals. 

[previewyoutube=8nSWbhHoZio;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ashran | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/90d532d3b77c84f94248199bfdd5d8655dbafa00.jpg[/img]

Ashran is one of the wizards who lives in Argnor, who has dedicated his life to the knowledge of black magic and forms part of the organization Santhniar. 

He is also one of the wizards of the Order of Ingham that, in ancient times, were exiled for practicing necromancy, a forbidden magic.

[previewyoutube=jATFFbSUFzY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Temple Warrior | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/f9aa9f0bc1d1b42aa6b6b82e65c34cbca5c2c03a.jpg[/img]

The Temple Warrior is a card belonging to the Mercenaries, so you can use it in any of your squads regardless of the element of the hero selected to create it.

It is a card that can become a nightmare for the enemy thanks to its ability "Anger 1", with which it gets 1 attack point every time he receives an attack. Introducing the Temple Warrior into an Earth element squad with healing abilities can make for a very difficult combo to beat.

[previewyoutube=M7mNxZzbmsw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ystli Princess | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/266adb7e7b0362bdbfca781a59e5d93847c961cc.jpg[/img]

In the heart of the ocean the city of Ystli can be found.

Nobody that doesn't live there has been able to get through its walls. Any traveller that enters Ystli will never be able to leave, and not only because the path to Ystli must stay a secret but because even though the traveller may be able pass unscathed, the Athua ocean has never been a safe place for a solitary wanderer.

Only few receive permission to exit the city and it's often to do with important state matters and with the Elders Council's authorization.

[previewyoutube=rqkDe9xF5jg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Blazing Rock Warrior | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/762c56b2b7b5d3c232f16a93ea3aa950cf421dc4.jpg[/img]

The Blazing Rock Brotherhood is made up of a multitude of mountain tribes that live in the western part of the Bhauhk mountain range. The population is divided into four big main tribes: The Henok, The Gunne, The Ingemar and The Knut.

The Blazing Rock Warrior makes up part of The Henok. His height, impressive muscle mass and warlike character stands out.

[previewyoutube=sfNamVSaoyQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Akkenian Warrior | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/6aaa5024fd58ae312fb3a637fd27d2241d1b787d.jpg[/img]

The Akkenians are a tribe that inhabit the plains of Idhun. They usually have a dark complexion, which gives them that distinctive look.

The Akkenian Warrior is a very powerful unit since for only 3 crystals you have a creature with 2 attack points and 5 health, which thanks to the ability "Concentration 1" increases its attack by 1 point each turn.

[previewyoutube=6QlCLQcgXJw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Red Dryade | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/ba5ca0599e6c9d70ac65016d24dfa1d57b57be00.jpg[/img]

Red Dryade is a very powerful and resistant creature that can be very useful when fighting against flying units, since thanks to the ability "Under cover" it does not take damage from the attacks of creatures with the ability "Fly".

In addition, it has the ability "Heal 1", so it restores 1 health point to the most damaged allied card at the end of each turn.

[previewyoutube=pM_vKltMyD0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dark Priest | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/7a733418548a10194c186d152e5ae585106c7857.jpg[/img]

As we have said in previous posts, we are going to start presenting you the card reveals of the Beta phase.

And what better way to start than by presenting the last card we released from the Alpha phase?

Here you have the Dark Priest!

[previewyoutube=fOCjmQuFjZY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Berserk Reborn | Trailer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/faeab3d6d65b7c543460dd42fb0f683417865a2f.jpg[/img]

At last the time has come!

The video that we present to you today is the official trailer for Berserk Reborn. It consists of art animations of different cards that will be found in the Beta of the game and animations to show what the Berserk battlefield will be like.

This is just a little bit of everything that is to come, but we hope you enjoy the video as much as the excitement that this publication brings us.

See you in Udhin!

[previewyoutube=KEH7HY9-UOw;full][/previewyoutube]
